description_en: Queries information about one or more cloud disks that you have created in a dedicated block storage cluster
description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的专属块存储集群的云盘信息
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-dedicated-block-storage-cluster-disks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF2 --dbsc-id dbsc-cn-od43bf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专属块存储集群所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为500。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The dedicated block storage cluster ID
parameters.name: dbsc_id
